let rec outer (lst : List Int) (i : Nat)
            : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
        match lst with
        | [] =>
            none
        | x :: xs =>
            let rec inner (lst' : List Int) (j : Nat)
                    : Option Nat :=
                match lst' with
                | [] =>
                    none
                | y :: ys =>
                    if x + y = target then
                        some j
                    else
                        inner ys (j + 1)
            match inner xs (i + 1) with
            | some j =>
                some (i, j)
            | none =>
                outer xs (i + 1)
        outer nums 0
